```{r setup, echo = F, warning = F, message = F}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(eval = T, echo = F, message = F, warning = F)
library(seafisheries)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lubridate)

source(here::here("workflows", "config", "config_alb.R"))
source(here::here("workflows", "R", "diag_helpers.R"))   # ktab()

sp   <- tolower(species)
sp_w <- paste0(sp, "_w")
dir.create(dest_folder_seapodym, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Model grid and mask

Domain (`stock_domain`), resolution (`seapodym_res`) and mask
(`seapodym_mask_file`) of the SEAPODYM configuration, from the config.
Catch-effort records on land or outside the domain are removed: a record is
kept if a sea cell of the model covers it.

```{r grid}
grid <- make_seapodym_grid(stock_domain$lat, stock_domain$lon, seapodym_res, mask_file = seapodym_mask_file)
# stops if the mask does not have one value per cell of the grid
mask <- read_seapodym_mask(grid)
ktab(data.frame(
	item = c("latitude (edges)", "longitude (edges)", "resolution (deg)", "cells", "sea cells", "mask folder", "mask file"),
	value = c(paste(grid$lat, collapse = " to "), paste(grid$lon, collapse = " to "), grid$res,
			  nrow(mask), sum(mask$value > 0),
			  dirname(seapodym_mask_file), basename(seapodym_mask_file))),
	caption = "SEAPODYM grid")

# year window of the outputs (seapodym_years; NA = no limit on that side)
yr_from <- if (is.null(seapodym_years) || is.na(seapodym_years[1])) -Inf else seapodym_years[1]
yr_to   <- if (is.null(seapodym_years) || is.na(seapodym_years[2])) Inf else seapodym_years[2]
inYears <- function(yr) yr >= yr_from & yr <= yr_to
```

# EC data

Fisheries are numbered across gears in the order of `seapodym_inputs`
(gear group + number). The dummy fishery D comes last: catch without effort of
every gear and catch of the other gears not in `oth_fisheries`, written with
effort 0 (catch removal only). It has no Hampel filter and no length data.

```{r ec}
read_inputs <- function(files, what) {
	ok <- file.exists(files)
	if (any(!ok)) message(what, ": not found, skipped: ", paste(files[!ok], collapse = ", "))
	if (!any(ok)) return(NULL)
	bind_rows(lapply(files[ok], readRDS))
}

# effort: adjusted by the Hampel filter if requested and available
ec_effort <- function(d) {
	if (hampel_adjusted_effort && "adjusted_E" %in% names(d))
		d$E <- dplyr::coalesce(d$adjusted_E, d$E)
	d
}

CE_list <- list()
for (g in names(seapodym_inputs)) {
	d <- read_inputs(seapodym_inputs[[g]]$ec, paste("EC", g))
	if (!is.null(d)) CE_list[[g]] <- ec_effort(d) |> mutate(gear = g)
}

# dummy fishery: catch without effort of every gear, 5 deg cells, effort 0
dummy_ok <- file.exists(seapodym_dummy)
if (any(!dummy_ok)) message("Dummy files not found, skipped: ", paste(seapodym_dummy[!dummy_ok], collapse = ", "))
CE_dummy <- bind_rows(lapply(names(seapodym_dummy)[dummy_ok], function(n)
	readRDS(seapodym_dummy[[n]]) |>
		mutate(source = if ("reason" %in% names(pick(everything()))) paste0(n, ": ", reason) else n) |>
		transmute(source, yr = year(ymd), mm = month(ymd), dd = 15,
				  lat = roundTo2.5(latCent), lon = roundTo2.5(lonCent),
				  res = 5, E = 0, C = .data[[sp_w]]))) |>
	filter(C > 0)
dummy_tab <- CE_dummy |> group_by(source) |>
	summarise(records = n(), catch = round(sum(C), 1), .groups = "drop")
names(dummy_tab)[3] <- paste(species, "catch (mt)")
ktab(dummy_tab, caption = "Dummy fishery D by origin")
if (nrow(CE_dummy)) CE_list[["D"]] <- CE_dummy |> mutate(f = 1, gr = "D", gear = "D") |> dplyr::select(-source)

# fishery labels: gear code + number, numbered in the order of the gears
offset <- 0
corresp_fisheries <- NULL
for (g in names(CE_list)) {
	fs <- sort(unique(CE_list[[g]]$f))
	corresp_fisheries <- bind_rows(corresp_fisheries,
		data.frame(gear = g, f = fs, f2 = paste0(g, seq_along(fs) + offset)))
	offset <- offset + length(fs)
}
fisheries <- corresp_fisheries$f2
nb_f <- length(fisheries)

CE_all <- bind_rows(lapply(CE_list, function(d)
	d |> dplyr::select(gear, f, yr, mm, dd, gr, lat, lon, res, E, C))) |>
	left_join(corresp_fisheries, by = c("gear", "f")) |>
	filter(inYears(yr))

n_before <- CE_all |> group_by(f2) |> summarise(records_in = n(), catch_in = sum(C), .groups = "drop")
invisible(utils::capture.output(CE_all <- apply_seapodym_mask(CE_all, mask, grid)))

file_CE <- sprintf("%s/%s_catch_%sf_%s.txt", dest_folder_seapodym, sp, nb_f, seapodym_version)

CE_out <- CE_all |>
	mutate(f = factor(f2, levels = fisheries)) |>
	group_by(f, yr, mm, dd, gr, lat, lon, res) |>
	summarize(E = sum(E), C = sum(C), .groups = "drop") |>
	dplyr::select(f, yr, mm, dd, gr, lat, lon, res, E, C) |>
	arrange(f, yr, mm)
format_EC(CE_out, file_CE, progress = FALSE)

ec_tab <- CE_out |> group_by(fishery = f, gear = gr) |>
	summarise(records = n(), effort = round(sum(E)), catch = round(sum(C), 1),
			  years = paste(range(yr), collapse = "-"), .groups = "drop") |>
	left_join(n_before |> rename(fishery = f2), by = "fishery") |>
	mutate(removed = round(catch_in - catch, 1)) |>
	dplyr::select(fishery, gear, records, effort, catch, removed, years)
names(ec_tab)[5:6] <- c(paste(species, "catch (mt)"), "removed by mask (mt)")
ktab(ec_tab, caption = "Fisheries in the catch-effort file (effort: unit of the gear)")
mask_txt <- sprintf("Mask: %s records and %s mt of %s catch removed (on land or outside the domain), %.2f%% of the catch.",
					format(sum(n_before$records_in) - nrow(CE_all), big.mark = ","),
					format(round(sum(n_before$catch_in) - sum(CE_all$C), 1), big.mark = ","), species,
					100 * (1 - sum(CE_all$C) / sum(n_before$catch_in)))
```

Catch-effort file: `r basename(file_CE)`. `r mask_txt`

# LF data

```{r lf}
LF_list <- list()
for (g in names(seapodym_inputs)) {
	d <- read_inputs(seapodym_inputs[[g]]$lf, paste("LF", g))
	if (!is.null(d)) LF_list[[g]] <- d |> mutate(gear = g)
}

file_LF <- sprintf("%s/%s_LF_%sf_%s.txt", dest_folder_seapodym, sp, nb_f, seapodym_version)
file_LF_regions <- sprintf("%s/%s_LF_regions_%sf_%s.txt", dest_folder_seapodym, sp, nb_f, seapodym_version)

LF_all_gr <- bind_rows(LF_list) |>
	left_join(corresp_fisheries, by = c("gear", "f")) |>
	filter(!is.na(f2), inYears(yr)) |>
	mutate(f = f2) |>
	dplyr::select(-f2, -gear) |>

	mutate(count = replace_na(count, 0)) |>

	# regions smaller than a model cell -> the model cell containing them
	expand_lf_regions(grid, res = if (is.null(lf_region_res)) grid$res else lf_region_res) |>

	# Summarize by quarter, then make mm as center of quarter
	group_by(f, yr, qtr, lon_from, lon_to, lat_from, lat_to, len) |>
	summarize(count = sum(count), .groups = "drop") |>
	mutate(mm = (qtr - 1) * 3 + 2) |>

	# Bring back samples (=f/yr/qtr/reg) with more than lf_max_fish fish to lf_max_fish fish
	group_by(yr, qtr, f, lon_from, lon_to, lat_from, lat_to) |>
	mutate(tot_count = sum(count)) |> ungroup() |>
	mutate(count = ifelse(tot_count <= lf_max_fish, count, lf_max_fish * count / tot_count)) |>
	dplyr::select(-tot_count) |>

	mutate(len = factor(as.character(len), levels = length_bins)) |>
	pivot_wider(names_from = len, values_from = count, names_expand = TRUE) |>
	mutate(across(!c(yr, qtr, mm, f, matches('[(lon_)|(lat_)]')), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))) |>
	arrange(yr, qtr, mm, f, lon_from, lon_to, lat_from, lat_to)

format_LF(LF_all_gr, file = file_LF, file_regions = file_LF_regions,
		  length_bins = length_bins, min_len = min_len, progress = FALSE)

ktab(LF_all_gr |> mutate(fishery = factor(f, levels = fisheries)) |>
	 	group_by(fishery) |>
	 	summarise(samples = n(), years = paste(range(yr), collapse = "-"), .groups = "drop") |>
	 	mutate(fishery = as.character(fishery)),
	 caption = "Length samples per fishery in the length-frequency file")
```

Length-frequency file: `r basename(file_LF)`.

# Readme

```{r readme, comment = ""}
code_version <- tryCatch(
	system2("git", c("-C", here::here(), "rev-parse", "HEAD"), stdout = TRUE, stderr = FALSE),
	error = function(e) NA_character_, warning = function(w) NA_character_)
if (!length(code_version) || is.na(code_version[1]))
	code_version <- paste("seafisheries", as.character(utils::packageVersion("seafisheries")))

file_readme <- sprintf("%s/readme.txt", dest_folder_seapodym)
cat(sprintf("%s %s:

Date: %s
seafisheries code version: %s
SQL download: %s
Processed data: %s
Stock domain: lat %s, lon %s (cell edges)
SEAPODYM grid: %s deg, mask %s
Years: %s

Longline fisheries
  cluster file:         %s (last modified %s)
  scenario:             %s, K = %s, %s
  incomplete records:   %s, prior %s (%s), reference years from the clustering
  delta:                reconciled per %s, logbook mix from coverage >= %s, thr_E = %s
Other gears:            %s; fisheries %s, other gears to D
Dummy fishery D:        catch without effort from %s
Hampel-adjusted effort: %s

Length bins:            %s cm, %s-%s cm; samples capped to %s fish

Fisheries:              %s

SEAPODYM files:
Catch-effort data:      %s
Length frequency data:  %s
",
	species, seapodym_version, Sys.Date(), code_version[1], request_tag, save_folder,
	paste(stock_domain$lat, collapse = " to "), paste(stock_domain$lon, collapse = " to "),
	grid$res, seapodym_mask_file,
	if (is.null(seapodym_years)) "all" else
		paste(ifelse(is.na(seapodym_years), c("first", "last"), seapodym_years), collapse = " to "),
	cluster_file, if (file.exists(cluster_file)) format(file.info(cluster_file)$mtime) else "not found",
	fisheries_tag, k_opr,
	if (is.null(merge_clusters)) "no merging" else
		paste(sapply(names(merge_clusters), function(n) paste(toString(merge_clusters[[n]]), "merged into", n)), collapse = "; "),
	assign_method, assign_prior, paste(sapply(assign_prior_tiers, paste, collapse = " x "), collapse = " > "),
	paste(assign_delta_group, collapse = " x "), assign_delta_coverage, thr_E,
	if (is.null(oth_gears)) "all gears except L, S, P" else paste(oth_gears, collapse = ", "),
	if (is.null(oth_fisheries)) "one fishery per gear" else
		paste(paste(names(oth_fisheries), sapply(oth_fisheries, paste, collapse = "+"), sep = ": "), collapse = "; "),
	paste(names(seapodym_dummy)[dummy_ok], collapse = ", "),
	hampel_adjusted_effort,
	bin_len, min_len, max_len, lf_max_fish,
	paste(fisheries, collapse = " "),
	file_CE, file_LF),
	file = file_readme)
cat(readLines(file_readme), sep = "\n")
```

# Fisheries report

Maps, catch and effort series and length distributions of the fisheries,
read back from the two files above: `r basename(sub("\\.txt$", "_report.pdf", file_CE))`.

```{r fisheries_report}
seapodym_fisheries_report(file_CE, file_LF, species = species,
						  title = paste(species, seapodym_version, "SEAPODYM fisheries"))
```
